en-US.question: Can systems be customized for non-standard substrate sizes and cleanroom environments?
en-US.answer: Yes. Both optical gantry spans and motion stage stroke lengths can be tailored to custom carrier dimensions, with ISO Class 5 cleanroom-compatible cabling and materials available.

zh-CN.question: 设备是否支持非标载具尺寸定制与无尘洁净室环境改造？
zh-CN.answer: 支持。光学龙门跨距与直线平台行程均可按客户载具图纸定制，并可选配符合 ISO Class 5 标准的低发尘拖链与密封材料。

en-US.question: How is sample evaluation conducted before placing an OEM order?
en-US.answer: Send sample assemblies or CAD drawings to our application lab. Within 48 hours of receipt, we provide a full repeatability report, cycle-time simulation, and imaging dataset.

zh-CN.question: 在正式采购或 OEM 合作前，如何进行样品实测评估？
zh-CN.answer: 您可将测试样品或 CAD 图纸寄送至我们的应用实验室，收到样品后 48 小时内即可出具完整的检测重复性报告、节拍测算与实拍图像集。
